item.title: DeepSeek uses banned Nvidia chips for AI model, report says
item.description:
📝 23% (Bloomberg) -- Chinese artificial intelligence startup DeepSeek has relied on Nvidia Corp. Nvidia’s Blackwell chips were smuggled into China through countries that permitted their sale, The Information reported, citing unnamed sources. More specifically, DeepSeek tapped chips that were installed in data centers in unspecified countries, then dismantled and shipped to China after clearing inspection by companies developing server equipment, The Information said.
